description: Undoes an ordinary close, to correct the year: the entries it wrote are reversed, never deleted, and the year accepts entries again. Entries already posted in later years do not prevent it and are not touched — they read this year from the ledger, so closing it again carries the corrected result to them. Refused for a year under a final close (fiscal_year_finally_closed), for everybody, and while a later year is closed (later_fiscal_year_closed): reopen that one first. Always ask the user before calling it.

fiscal_year_id.description: The closed year to open again.

name: reopen_fiscal_year
title: Re-open a closed fiscal year
